jobs.title: Celebrating the Women Who Drive Our Values
jobs.description: 2026 International Women's Day | Freightos Skip to content International Women’s Day 2026 We asked our Freightos team members to nominate the women who best embody our core values. This gallery showcases those peer-nominated stories—a tribute to the leaders and innovators who shape our community and drive our success. Abril Ramos Product Manager Abril is the kind of Product Manager who doesn’t just manage tasks—she elevates the entire team. Known for her infectious energy and efficiency, she’s a champion of culture who celebrates every win, no matter how small, and isn’t afraid to stand up for what’s fair. From reorganizing workflows to smoothing out sprints, her impact on our organization and goal-setting has been huge. By fostering a collaborative, supportive environment, she’s helped us reduce incidents and boost platform stability. She truly embodies the spirit of being here for each other while constantly evolving. Andrea Indave VP HR Andrea is the gold standard for leadership. As a pillar of the HR team, she balances deep emotional intelligence with a sharp, pragmatic strategic vision. Whether she’s guiding the company through change or working behind the scenes to support individual growth, her impact is felt across the entire organization. Colleagues describe her as incredibly accessible, and the kind of leader who makes navigating challenges look easy. By truly putting people first and consistently leaving a mark on our global initiatives, Andrea helps us all perform at our best. Andrea Martinez QA Engineer Andrea is the ultimate quality champion. Working behind the scenes in R&D, she’s been a rock of stability, proactively identifying issues before they even reach our customers and helping the team move faster with total confidence. Her technical expertise and sharp attention to detail have not only raised the bar for our standards but also fostered a proactive quality mindset across the board. By leading by example and representing a strong, vital female voice in technical spaces, Andrea has turned high-pressure projects into smooth, successful deliveries. She truly helps us evolve—constantly. Anna Towarek Project Manager Anna has been an absolute powerhouse in project management this year. She’s spearheaded the Ocean implementation, driving it forward through immense complexity. What makes her contribution so impressive is how she’s kept development momentum going for huge initiatives while navigating challenges like team rotation and resource constraints. Anna proves that when the stakes are high, deep expertise and tenacity are exactly what help us evolve and leave a lasting mark. Antonia Ambrozy Director of Revenue Operations Antonia is our resident “queen of all trades,” and she has truly transformed Revenue Operations this year. By evolving from a reactive support function into a strategic revenue enabler, she’s turned operational chaos into clear, structured workflows—from CRM revamps to commission tracking and automation. Beyond the technical wins, Antonia is the definition of “here for each other,” always ready to jump in, help other teams, and ensure everyone has what they need to succeed. She leads with empathy, dedication, and a relentless focus on getting things right. Antonia is an absolute powerhouse! Arpita Roy Data Associate Arpita is a fantastic example of what it means to “Evolve. Constantly.” Returning to the team after a year away, she didn’t just pick up where she left off—she hit the ground running as a top performer. Her dedication to actively supporting the US market is unmatched, and her willingness to relocate to Chennai to ensure her requirements were met shows just how committed she is to the team’s success. We’re thrilled to have her energy and expertise driving results for us! Chani Walker Office Manager Chani is the ultimate backbone of our office and a true “ray of sunshine.” From managing the move to our new space to solving daily challenges (and heroically dealing with broken coffee machines!), she makes sure every person feels valued and included. Whether it’s remembering dietary restrictions or just checking in to see how you’re doing, Chani leads with genuine warmth. She is the embodiment of “We Put People First,” ensuring that our workplace isn’t just an office, but a truly welcoming home for everyone. Cristina Sampaio Senior Product Design Manager (UX/UI) As UX Senior Manager, Cristina brings intentional, clear leadership to even the most complex challenges, ensuring our teams are always aligned on shared standards and goals. By pushing us to be more strategic and consistent in how we build, she’s not only created clearer roadmaps but has helped us deliver better, more cohesive user experiences. With Cristina, we move faster, work with greater purpose, and truly “leave a mark” on every product we ship. Delaney Penn Sales Executive Delaney is a true industry veteran whose deep experience is matched only by her genuine, infectious passion for freight. Colleagues don’t just work with her—they look up to her, inspired by her unique ability to relate to everyone she meets. Beyond her expertise, Delaney brings a level of sincere care that makes our customers feel truly supported and valued. Whether she’s growing our customer base or boosting eBooking numbers, she’s consistently leaving a mark on everything she touches. She proves that when you combine drive with authenticity, you make an impact that really lasts. Dhivya R R&D Team Lead Dhivya is the glue that keeps our team connected. She approaches every interaction with a warm, genuine demeanor that instantly puts people at ease. She doesn’t just stop at being friendly; she proactively creates opportunities for deeper team involvement, making collaboration easier and more engaging for everyone. By keeping the team focused and connected, she is a fantastic example of what it means to live our value of “We Put People First.” Elodie Guillard Director of Marketing Elodie is more than just a Mark
